concepts.description: A modular unit of the AUV system that encapsulates related components and functionality.
A physical or logical platform within the AUV module that interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV module communicate, specifying values and events.
A component within the AUV module responsible for managing and directing the behaviour of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module representing fundamental value kinds.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that groups multiple values of potentially different types.
A named data field contained within an Interface, representing a piece of information communicated through the interface.
A named occurrence or signal defined within an Interface that can be triggered, optionally with parameters and a return value.
A named computational unit defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator outputs.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operator commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller within AUV_Module representing the Last Response Engine, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller within AUV_Module responsible for autonomous piloting, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the radial component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the polar component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A field of the SVec composite type representing the azimuth component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the north-south relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the east-west relative distance, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the depth of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the identifier of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of the Obstacle composite type representing the heading of the obstacle, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing the heading of the AUV, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing obstacle data detected by the AUV, of type Obstacle.
An interface defined by AUV_Module (intended as Inputs) that defines events for task and mode control.
An event in the Intpus interface signalling the end of a task, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting obstacle collision mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting manual operation mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting heading control mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting velocity, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting heading, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Outputs interface advising velocity, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
An event in the Outputs interface advising heading, taking one parameter of type real and no return value.
A composite type representing a close-distance record, containing horiz_cda, vert_cda, and id fields.
A field of the Close composite type representing the horizontal closest distance of approach, of type real.
A field of the Close composite type representing the vertical closest distance of approach, of type real.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
